Definition: Faith — trust, belief and faithfulness; active reliance on God and His promises, expressed in allegiance and obedience.
BiblicalUsage: Pistis can mean both our trust in God and faithfulness itself — Hebrews 11 parades men and women whose faith acted, endured and obeyed. Paul insists the righteous live by pistis from first to last.
TheologicalSignificance: Pistis is not believing in spite of evidence but trusting a trustworthy Person. Faith is the hand that receives grace and the feet that keep walking with God.
